speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot is new, and it is pasteboard, and it hangs by the stage door. A man may read his entrance without asking me which play he is in.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The yard is three times the Cross Keys. What I wrote for a room is too small, and it is too quick.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then I am too small and too quick, and I will not stay so. Give me the length of the boards, Will. Do not give me a parlour and call it a field.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou hast Berowne, and Berowne was a room. The room has become this. Find him on it. I have Navarre, and Navarre feels the same fault.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: The cue is Latin. I cannot hear it from behind the arras. I have missed the entrance three times. The third time I was already in the wrong place, which is a kind of punctuality.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, one tag. If a tag cannot be heard, it is not a cue. It is a private joke between a scholar and a door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The tag is satis quod sufficit. It is the end of the line, and the end is the part he cannot hear. That is my fault before it is his learning.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I have learned it. Learning is not hearing. Three misses is a number I can stand up in front of. I would like a word instead.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I can be heard, sir. The Princess does not shout. She arrives, and the arrival is the sound. My voice will do the yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It will, Nick. Do not swell it. Arrival is enough. Thou art sound, and I am not asking thee to be louder than the part.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: The hooks have split. Rosaline's waist is ahead of the bodice, and the growth is mine. I am not asking for a new lady. I am asking for a hook that admits the fact.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Hooks are not my plot. The plot says enter Rosaline. It does not say enter a bodice in distress. Edith is not in this yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Edith is not today's work. The hooks wait. I am not writing a hem this morning. The cue is the work.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art mending a constable's ear while Berowne is still the size of a chamber. The boards are the fact. Let me spend them.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Spend them. Item, we are not open. There is no bill on the door. Easter Monday is when the town is invited, and this morning is not Easter Monday.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Then I am missing an entrance for an empty yard, three times, at full seriousness. I can do it a fourth, if the tag stays Latin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not do a fourth. I am taking the roll home. The end of the line will become a word a man can hear through oak.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Through oak is a large promise, sir. I can speak through cloth. Oak is Cowley's problem, and I am glad it is his.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: If the lady is tall, the laugh is already in the hooks. You need not write it yet. I would rather a hook than a poem about my shins.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The hem is not the book. Give me one cue, the same on every copy, or I shall prompt from two truths and God help Dull.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, the roll goes home with you. I am not paying a copyist for two endings. One ending, or we rehearse the miss again and call it practice.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One ending. I will see both copies before I ask anyone for a new roll. Two men may already be holding two truths.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: See them. And see me on the boards before we are sent home. I am not leaving this morning the size I came in.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I will be heard on the same boards, sir. Send me in as I am. The yard did not frighten the arrival.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: Send me in with the split hooks, if you must. I would rather a hook than a poem.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I will stay behind the oak until the word is a word. That is the whole ask. I have already asked it by missing, three times.
